title: Rider Code of Conduct: Bus Referrals, Riding Suspensions and Courtesy Permit Revocation (Student Transportation Services)
content:
**Rule.** Each bus conduct referral of a Student Transportation Services rider is numbered within the school year and carries the riding suspension of the conduct ladder for that number, counted in school days starting the next school day. A step of 0 is a written warning without suspension, and the remainder of the semester runs to the last school day of the semester.

- **Numbering.** The offense number is the count of conduct referrals on the student's assignments of that school year, the new referral included. The school year runs July 1 through June 30.
- **Courtesy permit revocation.** At the type's revocation offense number a courtesy rider permit is revoked, closed as revoked for conduct, with no fee credit. Fee-free types are never revoked for conduct, only suspended.
- **Alternate transportation.** When the type requires it, the district provides alternate transportation during the suspension. For a Special Education Transportation student the suspension days count toward the student's removal days under the IEP.
- **Resuming.** Riding resumes the school day after the suspension's last school day.

## Ladder applied (hypothetical riders, ladder of the conduct figures)

| Rider | Referral | Offense number in the school year | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) rider | first of the year | 1 | written warning, no suspension |
| same rider | second of the year | 2 | 3 school days from the next school day |
| same rider | third of the year | 3 | the permit is revoked for conduct, no fee credit |
| Regular Route Eligibility rider | third of the year | 3 | 5 school days, no revocation |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation rider | fourth of the year | 4 | 10 school days; the district provides alternate transportation |

## Points of judgement

- **Referrals from an earlier school year** do not count; each school year starts the count again.
- **A referral on a Wednesday carrying 3 days (hypothetical)** suspends riding on the next three school days, and riding resumes the school day after the third.
